chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, al-Hamdani, Abu Muhammad. He had a connection with Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him).

key_terms.أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ: Abu Muhammad, a kunya (honorific name) used for Ali ibn Ibrahim.
key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan, a title referring to the sixth or ninth Imam, depending on context.
key_terms.وَصْلَةٌ: A close connection or bond, often implying frequent narration or direct contact with a scholar or Imam.

ai.seo_question: Who was Ali ibn Ibrahim al-Hamdani and what was his relationship with the Imams?
ai.summary: This entry identifies Ali ibn Ibrahim al-Hamdani as a narrator who maintained a close connection (waslah) with Imam al-Hassan (peace be upon him), indicating his reliability and proximity to the Imams.
